rationale: The whole point of the predicate: a producer must not be able to label its own claim as independently witnessed. This is rejected at EMIT time, not merely reported at verify — a receipt that cannot be produced cannot be shown to anyone. Classified `refused`, not `invalid`, and the difference is the substance: the producer will not build this receipt at all, so it never reaches a reader. A receipt that cannot be emitted cannot be shown to anyone.
